mapper.select: SELECT id, access_token_hash, assessment_date, revision, priority_preset, score_weights::text AS score_weights, expires_at FROM planning_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}

SELECT age_years, age_as_of_date, employment_status, available_cash_won, monthly_income_won, is_homeless, max_commute_minutes, additional_answers::text AS additional_answers, confirmed_at FROM profiles WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT id, slot_no, label, confirmed_address, housing_type, deposit_won, monthly_rent_won, maintenance_won, exclusive_area_m2 FROM candidate_homes WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY slot_no
mapper.update: UPDATE planning_sessions SET priority_preset = #{priorityPreset}, score_weights = CAST(#{scoreWeightsJson} AS jsonb), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}
